input: Set up a chore chart for the whole household

gold.taskTitle: Set up a chore chart for the whole household
gold.taskDescription: Create and implement a chore chart system that assigns household tasks to all members of the home.

questions.title: How many people are in your household?
questions.description: Understanding the number of household members determines how chores will be distributed.

questions.title: What are the ages of the people involved?
questions.description: Ages help tailor chore assignments to what is age-appropriate for each person.

questions.title: Which specific chores need to be on the chart?
questions.description: Knowing the exact chores ensures nothing important is left out of the plan.

questions.title: Should chores rotate between people or stay fixed?
questions.description: This determines whether assignments are permanent or cycle on a schedule.

questions.title: What time period should the chart cover?
questions.description: Knowing whether the chart is daily, weekly, or monthly shapes its structure.

questions.title: Will the chart be digital or printed and displayed?
questions.description: The format affects which tools or materials are needed to create it.

questions.title: Is there a reward or accountability system tied to it?
questions.description: Understanding whether there are consequences or incentives affects how the chart is designed.
